source_row.rationale: The CDC publishes specific catch-up immunization schedules to guide safely bringing a child who has fallen behind up to date on needed vaccines, generally without needing to restart already-completed portions of a vaccine series, helping ensure children still receive needed protection even if the original schedule was not followed exactly.
source_row.source_detail: 2025 schedule/addendum updated 2025-07-02: delayed vaccine series does not need to be restarted; accessed 2026-08-14.
